The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core weighted-risk algorithm is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.69 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 successfully validated the implementation in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is reusable, the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling beyond the primary success path.
